A '''space gunship''' was a model of [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], similar to the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]], used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], one such craft belonging to the [[unit]] [[Plo's Bros/Legends|Plo's Bros]] was utilized to evacuate the strike team sent to [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] during the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]].

These gunships were sealed for [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel, and had two external floodlights instead of the bubble turrets of the LAAT/i.

==Characteristics==
[[File:SpaceGunship-CR.png|thumb|left|250px|A space gunship flying past the [[Lola Sayu defense fleet/Legends|Lola Sayu defense fleet]].]]
This gunship model had its bubble turrets replaced with large external floodlights and was better equipped for space travel, having a sealed cabin.<ref name="EGCR" /> One known unit had the markings of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] gunships, [[Plo's Bros/Legends|Plo's Bros]].<ref name="CR" />

==History==
A space gunship was used during the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]]<ref name="CR" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="SWA-2011" /> The gunship passed through the blockade over the planet with the help of [[Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|three]] [[Adi Gallia's Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Delta]] [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|7B]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighters]] to rescue a strike team on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]].<ref name="CR" />

Space gunships were also used to land troops on the ground when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invaded]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

A [[Republic military base]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had a garrison of these gunships. At least two were used to track down [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] during her [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escape from the Republic military base]].
